questions.stem: Which pair of vectors is perpendicular?
questions.explain: Two vectors are perpendicular when their dot product is 0. Here 1·2 + 2·(−1) = 0, and the other pairs give 4, −5 and 24.
(x + y)(x + y) = x² + xy + yx + y² = x² + 2xy + y². The cross term 2xy is the part people forget.
The inside call gives f(−5) = 5, and then f(5) = 5. Applying f a second time changes nothing.

questions.stem: What is the dimension of the span of (1, 0, 1) and (2, 0, 2)?
questions.explain: The second vector is 2 times the first, so the two vectors span only a line, which has dimension 1.
The trace is the sum of the diagonal entries: 1/2 + 1/2 = 1.
